name: ai-memory (akitaonrails)
description: A single program (a small server) that records what coding agents do, turns it into Markdown wiki pages kept in git, and hands context to the next agent, whether that is Claude Code, Codex or another.
source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested.

installs_as.value: Local server (single binary) plus hooks and MCP config

offline_no_account.value: Yes: default path makes no LLM calls and needs no key

plain_files.value: Yes: git-backed Markdown wiki is the source of truth

footprint.value: Small: one binary plus SQLite, no model by default

claude_code.value: Yes: MCP config plus lifecycle hooks (read and write)

codex.value: Yes: MCP config plus lifecycle hooks

claude_desktop.value: MCP only in Chat; Code tab sessions are captured

survives_compaction.value: Search via MCP any time; compaction not described

undo_delete.value: Nothing hard-deleted; restore-page brings back old versions

service_failure.value: Agent launch continues; capture spools locally

uninstall.value: ai-memory uninstall --apply removes only what it installed

license_cost.value: MIT; no paid tier ("not a paid tier" for auth)
